entities.name: Indian Ocean Trade Network
entities.label: Movement
entities.summary: A vast pre-modern maritime trade system connecting East Africa, the Arabian Peninsula, India, Southeast Asia, and China. Active since antiquity and peaking in the medieval period, it facilitated exchange of spices, textiles, precious metals, and cultural ideas across civilizations.
